cross_source_overlap: No earlier IXI canonical roles found; unknown biological aliases and source/pretrained overlap remain. Known TopCoW-IXI and future derivatives inherit this source person. Any protected-role conflict must be resolved before intended-use admission, without silently changing prior roles.
person_linkage_basis: Exact source IXI ID; every paired T1/MRA also has identical site and acquisition-code filename prefix. The annotation descriptor explicitly retains IXI subject IDs. This establishes source identity linkage, not independent biological identity, simultaneous acquisition, common grid or accepted registration.
pretrained_exposure: SynthStrip evaluation includes IXI; exact version1 checkpoint membership/exposure unresolved. Do not call these cases unseen by that pretrained component.
source_kind: acquired healthy structural MRI and MRA with a derived100-person vascular annotation subset
source_role_claim: No publisher train/test split identified; these are prospective project roles

evidence_types.MRA: Genuinely acquired same-person vascular measurement; private reference, not automatically an actor channel
evidence_types.T1: Genuinely acquired structural image; prospective limited input after intended-use QC
evidence_types.vessel_mask: Derived SynthStrip/Frangi/manual-edited reference with reported surgeon review and incomplete sensitivity/coverage; distinct from acquired MRA

split_rule.held_out_claim: Internal person holdout only. No established unseen-pretrained, external-site or clinical evaluation claim; SynthStrip evaluation includes the IXI family and exact released-checkpoint exposure remains unresolved.
split_rule.identity: IXI followed by its exact three-digit source identifier; all modalities, visits, labels and known derivative aliases inherit one role
split_rule.payload_role_boundary: Root may authorize opaque mixed-role source archive staging. No member extraction, NIfTI header read, image array, annotation value or outcome access follows from byte intake. Later readers must enforce each role and declared input/private-reference fields.
split_rule.population: Union of original T1 and MRA source IDs from the complete authenticated TAR metadata inventory; retain missing-modality cases in their role and denominator
prohibitions: No unlabelled voxel interpreted as proven vessel-free
No vessel-mask intersection interpreted as clinical injury
For any held-out scored case, private MRA or annotation cannot affect actor features, action generation, action legality, stopping or nominal prediction before that strategy is frozen
TRAIN may support separately authorized privileged learning; this permission never makes private held-out anatomy available at deployment
SELECT may support declared method/checkpoint selection after frozen candidate scoring; no optimizer updates or population preprocessing fitted on SELECT
MEASUREMENT_EVAL cannot support calibration, method/hyperparameter selection, optimizer updates or population preprocessing fitting
No change to other collections' protected roles
split_rule.ranking: Ascending SHA256 of UTF-8(namespace + exact IXI identifier), then exact identifier; allocate contiguous ranks in role_order within each stratum
split_rule.role_preservation: Preserve every existing assignment and alias restriction; do not rerank a frozen cohort after QC failure, missing modality, future source addition or source correction
strata: source site code in original filenames
annotation ID present in publisher label preview
split_rule.stratum_ambiguity: A person with multiple site codes stays grouped; use a distinct unresolved or multi-site stratum, do not invent a site or remove the person to improve counts
split_rule.stratum_counts: Hamilton largest remainder: floor(n * percentage / 100), distribute remaining people by descending integer remainder; ties use role_order
